rationale: checkoutservice_cpu rose from 0.4289 to 18.2902 (+4164.9%, z=+226.43), by far the largest anomaly in the digest, with smaller mem (+38.5%) and socket (+21.8%) rises that are plausibly secondary effects. Confidence is medium because there are no warning or error logs, no latency series moved (checkoutservice_latency-50 only +5.7%), and the worst traces mostly go through frontendservice -> currencyservice rather than checkoutservice.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect checkoutservice for runaway CPU use (profile it, check recent deploys). If needed, restart or scale out checkoutservice replicas after confirming traffic can be drained safely.
